THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Matching pairs maker.

Two columns, one line each: draw the line on paper — or tap the pairs together on the screen.

Build the pairs

The left column stays put, the right column shuffles — so every sheet is a fresh little puzzle.

How many pairs?

FOR GROWN-UPS

On paper, your child draws one line per pair from the left column to the right — a proper pencil skill, and the answer page lines them up for checking. Solve on screen turns the same sheet into a tapping game: tap a card on the left, its partner on the right, and the pair joins with a bright line. A wrong tap just wiggles and hands the turn back; nothing is scored or stored. The shelves follow our classes — helpers and their tools from Class 33, animals and homes from Class 36, weather and what we wear from Class 34 — plus big-and-little letters for first readers.
